cause: Old reservation prices all padded input at 4 microUSD/token. Actual includes 1h cache creation; CLI max-budget is checked after model generation. Aggregate usage is zero for the final budget-stop result while cumulative modelUsage retains the consumed tokens. Collector settles actual, marks reservation overrun fatal, and validator rejects cumulative/aggregate mismatch.
preservation: All five parent freezes bound, exact changed D2 files archived, saved collection baseline immutable, ledgers/checkpoints prefix-verified. Clearance supersedes only exact saved target disposition; later fatal stops cannot inherit it.
reply_disposition: REPLY_FAILURE: output-length stop; no structured payload. Retain this generated attempt without resend. Other independently valid replies retain CHOICE/ABSTENTION and scores even when exceeding a reservation.
reservation_policy: Before each new call: retain original floors, enlarge input/output reservations from previously settled measured maxima plus 10%, round tokens upward to 64; enlarge money from measured maximum settled cost plus 10%, round upward to microUSD. Future settlements recompute all remaining reservations. Preserve exact pending nonstart request on resume.
scope: D3 harness-only; no model calls, network, pushes, git, or sibling edits
stop_rule: Reservation excess alone never stops or invalidates a reply. Unknown accounting and independent integrity/resource failures remain fatal. Cost stop only when settled + open holds + remaining reservations + protected reserve exceeds frontier USD25 or project USD39.
usage_source: cumulative modelUsage, only for budget_exhausted/error_max_budget_usd with zero aggregate and exact attributed cost agreement
